intitule: Resource: Identifying Active vs Passive Voice

enonce.texte: Analyze the following sentences. Identify whether each sentence is in the Active Voice or Passive Voice.

sousQuestions.texte: The meal is prepared by the chef.
The students have finished the project.
The project has been finished by the students.

intitule: Resource: Forming Passive Voice in Various Tenses

enonce.texte: Transform the following sentences from active to passive voice. Pay attention to the verb tense.

questions.reponse: 1. The report is written by the manager. 2. The car was repaired by the mechanic. 3. The homework will be done by the students.

sousQuestions.texte: The manager writes the report. (Present Simple)
sousQuestions.reponse: The report is written by the manager.

sousQuestions.texte: The mechanic repaired the car. (Past Simple)
sousQuestions.reponse: The car was repaired by the mechanic.

sousQuestions.texte: The students will do the homework. (Future Simple)
sousQuestions.reponse: The homework will be done by the students.

intitule: Resource: Passive Voice with Modal Verbs

enonce.texte: Transform the following sentences into passive voice using the same modal verb.

questions.texte: Transform to passive voice with modal verbs.
questions.reponse: 1. The letter must be sent. 2. The cakes can be made. 3. The book should be read.

intitule: Resource: Active vs Passive Voice in Context

enonce.texte:
Read the following paragraph. Identify the sentences that are in passive voice and explain why the passive voice is used in each case.

'The new library was opened last week. The mayor gave a speech during the ceremony. Many books have been donated by the community. The children enjoy the new reading area.'

questions.texte: Identify and explain passive voice usage.
questions.reponse: 1. 'was opened' - Passive, focus on the event. 2. 'have been donated' - Passive, focus on the books.

sousQuestions.reponse: 1. The new library was opened last week. 2. Many books have been donated by the community.
To emphasize the action (opening, donation) rather than the doer.

enonce.texte: You are a journalist in Cameroon. Write a short news report (8-10 sentences) about a recent event. Use the passive voice in at least three sentences.

questions.reponse: Example: A new school was opened in Yaoundé yesterday. The building was constructed by a local company. It was designed by a famous architect. The students were given new books. The ceremony was attended by many officials.

enonce.texte: Write a description of how a product (e.g., coffee, chocolate) is made. Use the passive voice to describe each step.

questions.reponse: Example: Coffee beans are grown on farms. They are harvested by workers. The beans are washed and dried. Then, they are roasted. Finally, the coffee is ground and packaged.

intitule: Resource: Passive Voice in Present Perfect

enonce.texte: Transform the following sentences from active to passive voice in the present perfect tense.

questions.reponse: 1. The letter has been written. 2. The dinner has been cooked. 3. The plants have been watered.

enonce.texte:
Rewrite the following informal email using a more formal tone. Use passive voice where appropriate.

Original: 'I want to inform you that we have received your application. We will consider it carefully. We will contact you next week.'

questions.reponse: Example: Please be informed that your application has been received. It will be considered carefully. You will be contacted next week.
